scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.json && cp ../../.ultrafuzz/topology.yml dist/topology.yml && rm -rf dist/templates && cp -R src/templates dist/templates
scripts.test: pnpm --filter @ultrafuzz/runtime... build && rm -rf dist-test && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && node scripts/run-tests.mjs && bun test dist-test/test/runtime.test.js --test-name-pattern 'generated Kimi'
scripts.test:kimi-contract: pnpm --filter @ultrafuzz/runtime... build && rm -rf dist-test && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && bun test dist-test/test/runtime.test.js --test-name-pattern 'generated Kimi'
